result.title: An Agent Architecture with Tools and Memory for Selective Correction of Wrist PPG Heart Rate Estimates
result.comment: 71 pages, including 48 pages of Supplementary Information
result.summary: Wrist photoplethysmography (PPG) heart rate estimates are vulnerable to motion artifacts, and corrections that reduce mean error can worsen individual windows. We propose an agent architecture with tools and memory around a fixed heart rate estimator. Pulse, motion, and limited historical evidence generate candidate estimates, whose predicted benefits and harms guide selection. An independent risk gate determines whether to retain, correct, or reject each output. We trained the architecture on PPG-DaLiA and tested it on Wrist Exercise, GalaxyPPG, and WildPPG with frozen weights. Across these four public datasets, mean absolute error (MAE), macro-averaged over ten estimators, decreased by up to 44.5%, with the largest reduction on GalaxyPPG. Beneficial and harmful corrections decreased and increased absolute error by more than 1 bpm, respectively. Their ten-estimator macro-averaged proportions ranged from 16.06% to 36.64% and from 1.68% to 6.77%, respectively, across the four datasets. At 60% and 80% target coverage, numerical correction on the same accepted windows contributed more to total error reduction than window selection. We implemented real-time wearable acquisition, Bluetooth reception, and smartphone deployment of a selected estimator and the framework. In backend analysis of four prototype recordings from one participant, ten-estimator macro-averaged MAE decreased from 9.09 to 4.45 bpm without additional rejection. Under the evaluated conditions, the architecture improved average accuracy while quantifying correction benefits and harms, supporting wearable heart rate analysis that considers error, correction risk, and coverage.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在固定的腕部 PPG 心率估计器周围构建带工具与记忆的智能体架构：由脉搏、运动与少量历史证据生成候选估计，依据预测收益与危害进行选择，并用独立风险门决定保留、纠正或拒绝；在四个公开数据集与可穿戴部署上评估误差与覆盖率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「风险门」在目标覆盖率下决定是否修改或弃权，以及候选择优时显式权衡收益与危害，可能与 LVR 中停止/弃权决策与额外计算的收益—成本权衡形成类比，可供核查；但任务与模态远离视觉推理，仅属概念层启发。
